name: past_tense
description: Give the past tense of an irregular English verb, few-shot. Control: same format copying the verb.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('go','went'),('eat','ate'),('see','saw'),('take','took'),('give','gave'),('come','came'),('run','ran'),('write','wrote'),('speak','spoke'),('drink','drank'),('sing','sang'),('swim','swam'),('drive','drove'),('ride','rode'),('fly','flew'),('know','knew'),('grow','grew'),('throw','threw'),('break','broke'),('choose','chose'),('freeze','froze'),('steal','stole'),('wake','woke'),('begin','began'),('ring','rang'),('sit','sat'),('stand','stood'),('find','found'),('think','thought'),('buy','bought'),('bring','brought'),('teach','taught'),('catch','caught'),('fight','fought'),('sell','sold'),('tell','told'),('make','made'),('feel','felt'),('leave','left'),('keep','kept'),('sleep','slept'),('meet','met'),('lose','lost'),('hold','held'),('fall','fell')]
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    items.append({"prompt":"Past tense:\n"+"\n".join(f"{a} -> {b}" for a,b in s[:3])+f"\n{s[3][0]} ->","answer":" "+s[3][1]})
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    control.append({"prompt":"Copy:\n"+"\n".join(f"{a} -> {a}" for a,b in s[:3])+f"\n{s[3][0]} ->","answer":" "+s[3][0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
